captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact macro camera lens with a matte black cylindrical barrel, a textured focus ring, and a glass front element. The main body is divided into an outer barrel, a ribbed focus ring that rotates continuously around the central axis, and an inner barrel containing the lens optics that extends forward on a prismatic joint. At the rear, a metallic grey bayonet mount is visible, complete with a small locking pin.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a macro camera lens with a compact cylindrical barrel. It must feature a rotatable focus ring with ribbed textures, an inner lens barrel that slides outward along the Z-axis for close focus, a transparent blue glass front lens element, and a metallic bayonet rear mount.
captions.factory: The code constructs the macro lens assembly using standard cylinders and boolean cuts. The outer barrel is modeled as a hollow cylinder with a tapered profile, while the focus ring is built by cutting radial grooves into a wider cylinder. The inner barrel holds a flat cylindrical lens element assigned a transparent blue material. These components are organized into separate parts connected by continuous (revolute) and prismatic joints to allow rotation of the focus ring and extension of the inner barrel.
